commit.message:
Share per-endpoint candidate data when building the DFA matcher (#70138)

* Share per-endpoint candidate data when building the DFA matcher

The same endpoint typically appears in many DFA states (for example a
parameter segment is reachable through every literal sibling). Each time,
DfaMatcherBuilder.CreateCandidate recomputed and reallocated the slots,
captures, complex segments and constraints arrays even though they only
depend on the endpoint. Cache them per endpoint for the duration of Build()
and share the (read-only) arrays between states. Endpoints with inline
constraints that are not known to be cacheable keep getting their own
instances, as before.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Only bypass cacheability check for the supplied parameter policy instance

A custom ParameterPolicyFactory can return a new (possibly stateful) policy
even when the route pattern supplies an instance. Only skip the
ICachableParameterPolicy check when the resolved policy is the supplied
instance itself (after unwrapping OptionalRouteConstraint).

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Only unwrap the exact OptionalRouteConstraint type when checking cacheability

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Align with repo copilot-instructions

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
